# Exceptional Magic

> Eight ways to multiply, and where they get you: the octonions, triality, the magic square and E8, drawn from the arithmetic and told plain.

https://nanobotco.github.io/exceptional-magic/

Reads: A. Garrett Lisi, "Division Algebras, Triality, and Exceptional Magic", arXiv:2609.12112v1 [math-ph], 10 September 2026, https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12112 —
licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Nothing from that paper is reproduced here; the mathematics is
recomputed from the definitions in this repository and the paper is cited where it is the
reason a topic is present.

## Numbers this site computes
- division algebras: 1, 2, 4, 8 — reals, complex, quaternions, octonions; split forms beside each
- the octonion table has 7 Fano lines, each unit on three of them
- sedenion zero divisors: 84 pairs of basis planes multiply to zero
- triality form T(v,psi,chi) cyclic on 4000 random triples, exact
- triality Lie algebras: su(2) 3, su(3) 8, sp(3) 21, f4 52 — tri(D) + 3 dim D
- magic square: dim = tri(A) + tri(B) + 3 dim A dim B, all 49 boxes agree with the named algebra
- root systems: G2 12, D4 24, F4 48, E6 72, E7 126, E8 240 roots
- E8 Coxeter number 30, eight rings of thirty in the Coxeter plane
- E8 triality split: 84 + 78 + 78 roots, 0 bracket violations on 13440 root sums
- E8 two-grading: so(16) 120 + spinor 128 = 248
- 139 checks run before publication, 0 failing

## Elsewhere from the same publisher

Made by Hongdam (https://hongdam.net/), a bilingual web studio in Chiang Rai.

- [Mot Dang](https://motdang.net/): city directory for Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai

- [Roads of Chiang Mai](https://motdang.net/roads/): the square of 1296, four rings, and what each one did to the city — counted from the map
- [wichaa](https://wichaa.net/): Lanna manuscripts, the amulet market, and the traditions around them
- [Hand Poke](https://nanobotco.github.io/hand-poke/): 28 traditions of marking skin by hand — the leg-tattoo zone of Burma, the Shan States and Lanna, counted
